original_card.question: Can a changed query demand or caller remove real work while satisfying native chronology and restoration?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A source-bound arbitrary-input identity and legal producer/consumer boundary with the complete paid and productive target invoice, including restoration, ownership, native alignment and extra charges. Price under the actual current model; historical ceiling.py assumptions must be established before use. A favorable optimistic relaxation keeps a route open but is not a completed supplier. A scoped local result remains useful; expansion requires the family-level budget gate.

first_step.inspect: Read revision 8, the selected review and live exact-source handoffs. Then follow this card's bounded first_experiment.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only, not a supplier replay or theorem proof.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose an exact caller and a new demand/interface hypothesis. Read the scoped #5617/#5631/#5649/#5747 and #5720/#5745 objections before rebuilding an excluded schedule. Compare the complete matched source/consumer protocols including all retained helper outputs. For an active-mode injection, first check #5745: its canonical delivery claim repays the eight removed centre jobs. Audit that exact claim or change its channel/feedback hypothesis; do not repeat the same free-injection search. Stop if the full favorable budget fails or the required restored output is unobservable.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.
scope_change_triggers: Changing source head, helper/cut domain, operation alphabet or caller boundary without recording the new scope.
Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

actual_scope: On the g=3, d=2 paired-star full-call contract, with exactly two thin maps and with the twelve F2 resolutions unchanged, decide whether total thin rank 6 or 7 occurs when the thin entries lie in the concrete field F4 = F2[a]/(a^2+a+1).
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether a changed caller or query demand removes real work. This session takes the entries-outside-F2 question left open by the F2 two-map census and answers it only over the named field F4, on the same two-map full-call contract. It keeps the caller, the paid bill, and kappa unchanged.
bottleneck_link: A two-map word of total rank 6 or 7 over an extension would show that the F2 rank-8 census is special to F2. The selected frontier stays 781451/250000000.
stop_rule: Stop after the F4 scalar extension of the exact polynomial two-map systems, including the classes that hit the frontier cap. Do not search F8, three thin maps, or a stage with three full calls.
evidence: verify.py checks the star matrix and the commuting control maps, then compiles search.c. The census prints proved_f4_classes=1562 and unresolved_f4_classes=184, then PASS_PAIRED_STAR_TWO_THIN_F4. Python 3.12, gcc, and OpenMP.

open_questions.question: Do the 184 F4 affine classes that filled the 2^20 frontier still have rank(Zg)+rank(Zh) at least 8?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Those classes are the only remaining place a two-map word on this contract could have total rank 6 or 7 over F4. The other 1562 classes are already settled.
open_questions.first_step: Take one nullity-32 class and prove that its two Schur complements have ranks summing to at least 4, then test whether that block shape covers every capped class.
open_questions.blocked_by: The stored frontier fills while the partial rank sum is still below 8. A larger table gets through another component and does not finish the next one inside this replay budget.

open_questions.question: Does some extension F_{2^k} with k>2 have a two-map word of total rank 6 or 7 on this same g=3, d=2 full-call contract?
open_questions.why_it_matters: An F4 point of rank sum at least 8 can sit in an affine space that also has an F8 point of rank sum 6 or 7. A finished F4 census would still leave that possibility open.
open_questions.first_step: Extend one nullity-7 class from F4 to F8 and compare the two minima. Use the same polynomial equations and the same star difference.
open_questions.blocked_by: Nothing external. Nullity 32 over F8 is too large to enumerate directly; a small-nullity class is enough for a first witness search.
